source: Average of Album’s Track Lyrics that are EMO*
claim: Averaging each album's track scores, black_parade has the highest average emo share at 19.16% and lilpump the lowest at 2.55%.

source: My Chemical Romance’s The Black Parade comes out on top
claim: black_parade has the highest album average, at 19.16% emo words, ahead of chemicalromance at 17.67%.

source: Juice Wrld’s Goodbye & Good Riddance and XXXtentacion’s ? follow closely behind.
claim: juicewrld averages 14.99% emo words and xxxtentacion 14.88%, behind black_parade's 19.16%.

source: For what it’s worth, both emo-rap albums are far ahead of Dashboard, Fall Out Boy, and Jimmy Eat World.
claim: juicewrld (14.99%) and xxxtentacion (14.88%) average more emo words than fall out boy (10.78%), dashboard (10.07%) and jimmyeatworld (7.64%).

source: As expected, artists such as Lil Pump and Migos appear lower on the emo scale, which means the data is roughly measuring what it’s supposed to.
claim: lilpump averages 2.55% emo words and migos 5.30%, putting both among the lowest album averages in the data.

source: We’ve also charted three of Kanye’s albums, from least to most emo: The College Dropout , 808s and the Heartbreaks , and Ye .
claim: kanye college_dropout averages 4.12%, kanye heartbreak 9.87% and kanye ye 13.08% emo words, in that order from least to most emo.

The ranked songs run from xxxtentacion's 'Pain = BESTFRIEND (Ft. Travis Barker)' at 56.52% down to tripple_trip's 'BANG!' at 23.08%, with tripple_trip's 'How You Feel' second at 54.74% and xxxtentacion's 'SAD!' third at 48.48%.

source: “Pain” by XXXTentacion is interesting as the top song.
claim: xxxtentacion's 'Pain = BESTFRIEND (Ft. Travis Barker)' has the highest emo-word share at 56.52%, ahead of tripple_trip's 'How You Feel' at 54.74%.
